{{Top|leg}}
'''Mallif''' were the native inhabitants of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Recopia]]. Descendants of the [[Seyugi Dervish]]es, they were mysterious religious monks, who broadcasted their strange philosophies through the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]]. A few of them continued to maintain the fortress on the [[Mallif Cove]], in which a thousand of Seyugi Dervishes were kept frozen in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], awaiting release.
